purpose: Teach: 連敗/概観/旧来/番地/大口/取り決め/売り手/融通

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、競合との連敗時にも諦めなかったぞ
lines.en: Father never gave up, even through losses to our rivals.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Quiet pride in the memory. Each phrase deliberate—not rushed. The tone of someone recalling a principle that shaped him. Slight pause before the last clause.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営概観を社員と共有されました
lines.en: Yes. Father shared his understanding of business with all of us.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation, eyes steady. Not merely agreeing—honoring. Warm undertone. Slower pace, as if speaking of something that mattered deeply to him. Careful and sincere.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、旧来の取引先を大事にされたぞ
lines.en: Father treasured our long-standing business relationships.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. A slight smile in the voice. The warmth of someone recalling generosity. Pace unhurried. Trailing softly on the final word, as if he's there again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは本社番地を縁起の良い場所に選ばれました
lines.en: Yes. He chose the headquarters location for its auspicious character.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering. Not boastful—admiring. Soft emphasis on the deliberateness of the choice. A moment of quiet reflection between clauses. The voice of someone who understands the weight of such decisions.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、大口注文を獲得する手腕がおありだったぞ
lines.en: Father had a gift for winning over large clients.
lines.style: Warm admiration in the voice. Eyes brighten slightly. The cadence of someone proud but not loud about it. Subtle emphasis on 'gift'—acknowledging both skill and grace. Trailing fondly on the last phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはお取引先と取り決めを明文化された
lines.en: Yes. He put those agreements in writing—made things clear with his partners.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. A note of quiet pragmatism underneath. Not stern—just precise. Pace steady. The tone of someone who learned from watching clarity prevent misunderstanding. Settled and sure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、売り手としての誇りを社員に伝えられたぞ
lines.en: Father taught us all what pride in honest work truly means.
lines.style: Warm, earnest opening. The voice lifts slightly—this matters. Not performed emotion, but genuine. Slow enough to let each word land. A kind of closure in the tone, as if imparting something he carried forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはお得意様への融通の利く対応を実践された
lines.en: Yes. He showed us how to be flexible and fair with the clients who mattered most.
lines.style: Final affirmation with quiet wisdom. A slight deepening of tone—the last word. Not rushed. The sense of summing up something large into simplicity. Composed, grounded, at peace with what he is remembering.
